start.dialog: The Merfolk Prince is visiting Brinegate for trade negotiations, but someone sabotaged his ceremonial kelp garment! Without it, he can't appear in public—it's a grave insult to his people! We need a replacement from the Deep Gardens, but they're guarded by territorial rays!
start.objective: Harvest ceremonial kelp from the Deep Gardens

progress.dialog: Beautiful kelp! But the Prince also needs a proper escort to the negotiations. The Merfolk respect strength and magic. You'll need to impress his honor guard in a display of skill—non-lethal, of course!
progress.objective: Defeat the Merfolk honor guard in a friendly sparring match

complete.dialog: The negotiations proceed! The Prince is impressed by your honor and skill! He gifts you this Tidecaller Pearl—when submerged, it lets you speak with sea creatures! A rare boon from the deep folk!

party_comments.kade: Merfolk are way more intimidating up close. Those tridents are huge!
party_comments.twist: Their magical technique is... primitive, but effective.
party_comments.nix7: Aquatic humanoid social structures: complex. Diplomatic protocols: learned.
